rows.name:
Welcome to Goth Isut, the capital
of the Holy See of Acedia.

rows.label: tlk4632027601_msg0002
rows.name:
We live peacefully by following the
teachings of Acedia spread by
His Holiness Malbeni.

rows.label: tlk4632027601_msg0003
rows.name:
Perhaps the key teaching is that
it's never too late, even criminals
can repent, live anew.

rows.label: tlk4632027601_msg0004
rows.name:
Our creed is that faith can guide
the hearts of believers back toward
a brighter path.
